content_text: [1/2 @gregoryblotnick] best L/S mgr I ever worked for, had these three words taped on his main monitor -- right by order entry 1. Patience 2. Discipline 3. USA = Use Stops Always 3rd one is what made him the best...mf just absolutely refused to lose $. but over 10-15 years, when you see what "refuses to lose $" does to a LT track record... its like compound interest where the brain #REFs out the mind simply cannot visualize the effect of: 1. how drawdowns just destroy a LT track (50% draw --> 100% rally to flat) 2. what "no down months" does to a LT track...basically compound interest math. return stream looked similar to what the multis are doing... so, while we see 1-2% monthlies, 10-15% annualized the rate at which dollars are CAGR'ing inside that machine, over 10-20 years, gets completely bonkers if I had to sum up who survives that long and who doesn't, its all this: risk manager hat > portfolio manager hat. --- [2/2 @gregoryblotnick] just like this...the mind reacts with "holy fuck what" https://x.com/gregoryblotnick/status/2067998346313134341?s=20
